flows.name: The compass shows its bolder ticks and larger direction letters during a journey
steps: Install the PR's shipped files as the ShortestPathForever folder (compare: no differing files; extra media/icon-400.png) beside ForeverCore and /reload
Follow a journey so the compass shows at the top of the screen
Confirm the ticks are 2 wide and the major tick taller, the gold centre bar is solid, and the W sits in the larger gold font a clear gap under its tick
Confirm the goal pin and its distance sit below the letters without touching them
